# Meet Hult Dubai

New for 2025, Hult Dubai is opening its doors as a home campus for
undergraduates majoring in marketing or entrepreneurship. Our ultra-modern
campus in the heart of Dubai Internet City (DIC) is perfectly positioned for
immersive business learning at the crossroads of East and West.

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)VIRTUAL
TOUR![hult-dubai-virtual-
tour](https://img2.storyblok.com/f/45434/1200x800/973ebd194e/hult-dubai-
virtual-tour.jpg)

Dubai is renowned for its modern infrastructure, luxury lifestyle, and world-
class amenities. The city is home to established multinational corporations as
well as disruptive startups, making Hult Dubai a great choice for ambitious
undergraduates interested in gaining on-the-ground experience in one of the
world’s fastest-growing economies.

Campus highlights

  * Welcoming community of Hult postgraduates and undergraduates, offering cultural, social, and professional networking opportunities

  * Dedicated study options for undergraduates majoring in marketing and entrepreneurship

  * Modern campus with high-tech classrooms and collaborative working spaces

  * Walking distance from the Metro, close to Dubai Marina and the beach, and well-connected to the city's major attractions

Clubs & societies

Examples of student-run clubs and societies you can find in Dubai include:

  1. Elite Billiard Club

  2. ESG Exchange Hub

  3. Football Club (Hult FC)

  4. Hult Analytics Club

  5. Hult Cross-Border Law Collaborative

![](https://img2.storyblok.com/f/45434/1200x800/09bdff1660/sf-event-google-
visit.jpg)

TEDxHultDubai

TEDx is an international community that organizes TED-style events celebrating
locally-driven ideas. This student organization brings TEDx to the Hult Dubai
community.

![](https://img2.storyblok.com/f/45434/1200x800/9cdb95b996/london-event-
alumni-panel-mixer.jpg)

Alumni panels

Hult alums in the Dubai area regularly come to campus to meet current
students, share their journey after Hult, and give future alumni the benefit
of their experience.

Dubai is a major business stronghold with a very strategic location. It has a
very large emigrant community making it a truly international city.
